environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. DynamoDB table 'UserTokens' has fine-grained access control via IAM policy condition keys on the task role. The task role's dynamodb:GetItem permission includes a condition requiring dynamodb:LeadingKeys to match the authenticated caller's identity token claim (from the ALB OIDC integration), meaning the service can only read items where PK equals the OIDC-authenticated user's subject. Additionally, the VPC security group restricts inbound to the ALB only, and the ALB has an OIDC authentication action configured on the listener rule that requires a valid IdP session before forwarding. The OIDC action uses Amazon Cognito with adaptive authentication (risk-based challenges) and enforces a per-user request throttle of 5 requests per 10-second window at the Cognito advanced security layer.

config.security_group_inbound: ALB security group only (sg-alb-xxxxx), no direct access
